notes.title: Muck Update4
notes.content:
Muckdate 4
Hey everyone,
Hope you're all vibing. This update features achievements and some new content. 

Big Changes

 I've added 40-50 achievements to Muck. 
 4 new original music tracks by Context Sensitive (Evan King)
 Trader Camps
 Now available for mac and linux, however I don't have the time or capacity as a solo dev to properly test and develop this, so there might be issues.

Trader Camps

 Trader Camps now spawn randomly around the map
 Woodmen run around in camps
 Some Woodmen have items to trade with you (buy / sell)

New Enemies

 Chief (Boss)
 Woodman (Traders)

Gameplay

 Mobs (hopefully) don't phase through trees and minerals anymore
 Can free cam spectate now by pressing any of the movement keys while spectating
 End screen now shows stats for all players

New Items

 Chiefs Spear (Rare)
 Spear Tip (Rare)
 Obamium Sword
 Obamium Armor

Balancing

 Mobs deal more damage to resources (not buildings)
 Decresed big chunk splash damage
 Bob is more aggressive with fireballs. Also tweaked some hitboxes for his landed attacks

Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug where ship engine would require more than 1 of each gem
 Fixed an issue where sometimes animations wouldn't play when spectating other players
 Fixed a bug where boss shrines didn't work in Versus mode

Other

 Character model has been slightly beefed up
 Chat commands now autofill commands and names
 Added a /kick command, so server host can kick players. Can also kick players in the lobby

notes.title: Muck Update3 (Story & Final boss)
notes.content:
Muckdate 3

Hey everyone,
Hope you're all doing well. I've been working on adding more content to Muck, as well as an actual story / ending to the game. 

Story

 There is now an ending to Muck, allowing you to complete the game. This is optional, and you can just ignore it if you wish to muck around forever,
 New unknown structure now spawns randomly somewhere on the island...

New Enemies

 Bob (Dragon)
 Guardian (Boss)

Gameplay

 You can now swim (and drown) 
 Changed terrain generation slightly
 Adjusted some difficulty curves (slightly harder)
 Mobs hopefully shouldn't phase through objects too much anymore

New Items

 Maps (Common)
 Gems (Rare)
 Night Blade (Rare)
 Black Shard (Rare)
 Ruby (Uncommon)
 Obamium Ore / Bar (Uncommon)

New Resources

 Obamium Ore
 Ruby
 Caves containing resources

Other

 Can see other players on map
 Fixed a bug where music wouldn't play
 Resources now always spawn a minimum amount, so you are guaranteed to find everything

Accessibility

 Can now invert mouse x and y axis separately


If you don't automatically get the update, try to reinstall the game :)
I'll be working on adding achievements next. Not sure what else, so leave some suggestions if there's anything specific you'd like.

notes.title: Muck Update2 (New boss, weapons, enemies & more)
notes.content:
Muck Update2


Hey everyone,

Here comes the first big content update, adding a new boss, fixing bugs, and a bunch of other stuff. 

New Enemies

 Gronk (Boss)
 Wolf

New Powerups

 Enforcer (Orange)
 Juice (Blue)
 Robin Hood Hat (White)
 Spooo Bean (White)

New Items

 Gronks Sword (Rare)
 Ancient Core (Rare)
 Blade (Rare)
 Sword Hilt (Rare)
 Ancient Bow (Rare)
 Ancient Bone (Rare)
 Dark Oak Wood (Uncommon)
 Elemental Arrows (Rare)
 Flax Fibers (Common)
 Wolf Armor Set (Uncommon)
 Wolfskin (Common)
 Wolf Claw (Rare)
 4 Mushroom soups

New Resources

 Dark Oak Trees
 Coal Deposits

Graphics

 Random atmoshpheres for each world
 Improved some visuals / animations

Other

 Boss Totems
 Grave / Revive system changes
 Mobs have weaknesses (Pickaxe is strong against golems, big chunk, etc)
 Free roaming enemies
 Stations no longer float
 Some armor sets now give bonuses if full set is equipped
 Singleplayer can now pause the game

Accessibility

 Inverted Mouse Options
 FOV Slider
 Fullscreen mode settings. Allows you to use Exclusive Fullscreen, which should hopefully fix some issues with recording the game

Balancing

 Made it harder since the game was too easy, especially mid/late game
 Nerfed Dracula Powerup & balanced some other powerups
 One shot protection on Easy and Normal

Optimizations

 Mobs shouldn't teleport anymore, but synchronize smoothly to their correct positions
 Might have fixed an issue where not all players would load in. But who knows if it actually works lol
 Might have fixed an issue where you get softlocked and can't take damage or pick up anything
 Might have fixed an issue where dropping an item while standing on several other items would send items into the void forever


If you don't automatically get the update, try to reinstall the game :)
Next up I'll be working on an actual story an ending to the game & more content

notes.title: Muck Update1
notes.content:
Muck Update1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466412/393bc3791e22f313e0f03d6c1b5661022ad3d72f.png

Hey everyone,

Thanks a lot for a pretty insane launch, already 500k downloads. I didn't really expect it to blow up so much, so I'll try to update very frequently, and keep up with everything.

There have been a lot of complaints about balancing, so I've made a bunch of changes to mob difficulties, especially Big Chunk. It remains almost unchanged for "Gamer" difficulty, but easy and normal should not be as hard anymore.

Big changes

 Changed item cap from 64 to 69
 New respawn system; on death you spawn a grave. Can only be used during day.
 Revive totems allow you to revive teammates without being close to the grave, but comes at a price.
 "Buff" enemies can now spawn randomly, and will drop better loot.
 Versus mode / Battle royale is now more fast pace, and you gather resources at 2x the speed. 

Minor changes

 Chest prices increase with time, hopefully to balance things out a bit more.
 Profanity filter. A few streamers have tried the game, and uh Twitch management. Need i say more?
 Free camera when spectating
 Displays when stations is in use


If you don't automatically get the update, try to reinstall the game :)
